description: This script extracts feature flag metadata from the 'superset/config.py' file by parsing comments and the DEFAULT_FEATURE_FLAGS dictionary, and outputs a JSON with grouped feature flags based on lifecycle annotations.

classes.name: FeatureFlag
classes.description: TypedDict defining the structure of feature flag metadata, including name, default value, lifecycle, description, docs URL, and category.

methods.name: extract_feature_flags
methods.description: Parses the config.py file to extract feature flag metadata from comments and the DEFAULT_FEATURE_FLAGS dictionary.

methods.name: parse_comment_lines
methods.description: Processes comment lines to extract metadata such as lifecycle, docs URL, category, and description for each feature flag.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that locates the config.py file, extracts feature flags, groups them by lifecycle, and outputs the JSON result.
